strings.<strong>Accessibility</strong> is reques: Accessibility is requested if you enable the optional search box in the Dock, so Strata can read the Dock’s layout and position the box alongside it.
strings.<strong>Checking other apps for updates:: Checking other apps for updates: when you ask Strata to check installed apps, it contacts their publishers’ update feeds or Apple’s App Store lookup service. App Store requests include the relevant app identifiers and store region.
strings.<strong>Content search, previews and sum: Content search, previews and summaries: supported documents are read locally. The content index can store extracted text and search data derived from it.
strings.<strong>File search and folder sizes:</s: File search and folder sizes: names, paths, sizes, dates and other file metadata are indexed locally so searches and size calculations can stay current.
strings.<strong>Full Disk Access</strong> lets S: Full Disk Access lets Strata browse protected folders and include more of your Mac in search and folder-size calculations. Without it, macOS limits which folders Strata can read.
strings.<strong>History and undo:</strong> file: History and undo: file operations record details such as source and destination paths, dates and file identities so Strata can show past operations and undo them safely.
strings.<strong>Preferences:</strong> settings,: Preferences: settings, favorite and frequently visited folders, saved searches, workspaces, window locations and saved server details are kept locally.
strings.<strong>Servers, network shares and clou: Servers, network shares and cloud folders: browsing, transferring or changing files on a connection you configure sends the requests and data needed for that action to the relevant server or provider. Cloud-folder downloads and uploads may also be handled by macOS or your cloud provider’s software.
strings.<strong>Strata updates:</strong> checkin: Strata updates: checking for an update contacts GitHub through the Sparkle updater; downloading an update also contacts the download host. Automatic checks are optional and can be changed in Settings → General. Update requests can include app or system information and normal connection metadata, such as your IP address. They do not include your files or search queries.
strings.A Mac with Apple silicon running macOS 2: A Mac with Apple silicon running macOS 26 Tahoe. Apple Intelligence is optional: without it, summaries fall back to a document’s key sentences and Ask Strata to its built-in rules.
